# R packages the test jobs need, one per line (blank lines and # comments ignored).
# Single-sourced here because .github/workflows/ci.yml both installs from this
# file and keys its package cache on its hash -- editing the list invalidates the
# cache automatically.
#
# Derived from the library() calls in the stage entrypoints the R tests source:
#   tidyverse   config/live_calibration/logger/bet_tracker/roster/sync/injury
#   httr2       injury_scraper, market_odds_engine, sync_rosters
#   httr        market_odds_engine
#   jsonlite    injury_scraper, market_odds_engine, sync_rosters
#   ranger      market_odds_engine
#   knitr       injury_scraper, market_odds_engine, roster_bottom_up_engine
#
#   gifski      tools/viz_common.R's render_animated_artifact(), which every
#               tools/gif_*.R script the viz tests execute goes through
#   patchwork   tools/gif_clutch_shot_worm.R
#   png         tools/viz_common.R
#   ggimage     tools/gif_net_rating_quadrant.R
#
# enhanced_model.R's tidymodels/xgboost stack is deliberately absent: that file
# is a straight-line training script, the tests only check it statically, and
# nothing here sources it.
tidyverse
httr2
httr
jsonlite
ranger
